Which Organisations Need the Most Attention

These aren't just the biggest organisations — they're the ones where something worth a second look keeps coming up: a shortfall approved anyway, terms that didn't match, dues that weren't cleared, and so on. An organisation showing up in several different categories (not just one) is more likely to be a real pattern worth a conversation, rather than a one-off slip.
